name: llava-bench-coco-pt
description: A Portuguese adaptation of a COCO-based multimodal benchmark intended to evaluate image understanding and vision-language responses in Portuguese. It contains COCO-style visual instances with Portuguese prompts/answers to test VQA/captioning performance of multimodal models. Useful for assessing Portuguese-language multimodal capabilities and localization of vision-language models.
reputation: Community-contributed Hugging Face dataset with limited but growing use for Portuguese multimodal evaluation.
